plugin.name: reskin_reporter
plugin.author: Rhuli
plugin.purpose: Identify an item before and after reskinning and report only the changes
plugin.description:
Usage: reskin report <item> [channel] reskin report last [channel] reskin report help
Examples: reskin report 1.'polished boots' gt reskin report boots reskin report last clan reskin report last
The plugin captures identify output only while this command is running, reskins the item, identifies it again, and reports score/stat/resist changes in one channel message.
If the channel is omitted, reports use the local Aardwolf echo command.
The "last" command repeats the most recent successful report without identifying or reskinning an item. Its channel also defaults to echo.
The help command displays local MUSHclient-coloured help and does not send anything to the game.

trigger.name: rr_reskin_not_allowed
trigger.match: ^(?<reason>.* either needs to be preserved, or cannot be reskinned\.)$

muclient.script:
local rr = { active = false, phase = nil, channel = nil, item = nil, beforeLines = {}, afterLines = {}, beforeData = nil, lastReport = GetVariable("rr_last_report") or "" }
local function trim(s) return ( tostring(s or "") :gsub("^%s+", "") :gsub("%s+$", "") ) end
local function signed(n) n = tonumber(n) or 0 return string.format("%+d", n) end
local function blankLine() Note("") end
local function resetReporter() EnableTrigger("rr_capture_line", false)
rr.active = false rr.phase = nil rr.channel = nil rr.item = nil rr.beforeLines = {} rr.afterLines = {} rr.beforeData = nil end
local function sendToChannel(channel, text) channel = trim(channel)
if channel == "" then channel = "echo" end
if string.lower(channel) == "echo" then SendNoEcho("echo " .. tostring(text or "")) else SendNoEcho(channel .. " " .. tostring(text or "")) end end
local function sendReport(text) sendToChannel(rr.channel, text) end
-- A trailing word is treated as a channel only when it appears here. -- This prevents an unquoted multi-word item from losing its final word. local reportChannels = { echo=true, say=true, gt=true, group=true, clan=true, clantalk=true, ct=true, gossip=true, barter=true, auction=true, question=true, answer=true, newbie=true, helper=true, spouse=true, yell=true, shout=true, racetalk=true, class=true }
local function parseItemAndChannel(arguments) arguments = trim(arguments)
local item = arguments local channel = "echo"
local possibleItem, possibleChannel = arguments:match("^(.-)%s+(%S+)$")
if possibleItem and possibleChannel then local key = string.lower(possibleChannel)
if reportChannels[key] then item = trim(possibleItem) channel = possibleChannel end end
return item, channel end
local function parsePairs(text, destination) for key, value in text:gmatch("([%a][%a%s]-)%s*:%s*([%+%-]%d+)") do key = trim(key)
if key ~= "" then destination[key] = tonumber(value) or 0 end end end
local function parseIdentify(lines) local result = { name = "Unknown item", id = nil, score = nil, stats = {}, resists = {}, error = nil }
local section = nil local collectingName = false local nameParts = {}
for _, rawLine in ipairs(lines) do local line = tostring(rawLine or "")
if line:find("You do not have that item", 1, true) then result.error = "You do not have that item." end
local nameStart = line:match("^|%s*Name%s*:%s*(.-)%s*|?%s*$")
if nameStart then collectingName = true nameParts = { trim(nameStart) }
elseif collectingName then local continuation = line:match("^|%s*:%s*(.-)%s*|?%s*$")
if continuation then table.insert(nameParts, trim(continuation)) else collectingName = false end end
local id = line:match("^|%s*Id%s*:%s*(%d+)")
if id then result.id = id collectingName = false end
local score = line:match("^|%s*Score%s*:%s*(%-?%d+)")
if score then result.score = tonumber(score) end
if line:find("| Stat Mods", 1, true) then section = "stats"
local remainder = line:match("Stat Mods%s*:%s*(.-)%s*|?%s*$") or ""
parsePairs(remainder, result.stats)
elseif line:find("| Resist Mods", 1, true) then section = "resists"
local remainder = line:match("Resist Mods%s*:%s*(.-)%s*|?%s*$") or ""
parsePairs(remainder, result.resists)
elseif line:match("^%+%-+") then section = nil
elseif section == "stats" then parsePairs(line, result.stats)
elseif section == "resists" then parsePairs(line, result.resists) end end
if #nameParts > 0 then result.name = trim(table.concat(nameParts, " ")) end
return result end
local function sortedUnionKeys(a, b) local seen = {} local keys = {}
for key in pairs(a or {}) do seen[key] = true end
for key in pairs(b or {}) do seen[key] = true end
for key in pairs(seen) do table.insert(keys, key) end
table.sort(keys) return keys end
local function colourDelta(delta) delta = tonumber(delta) or 0
if delta > 0 then return "@G" elseif delta < 0 then return "@R" else return "@W" end end
local function buildChanges(beforeMap, afterMap) local changes = {}
for _, key in ipairs(sortedUnionKeys(beforeMap, afterMap)) do local old = tonumber(beforeMap[key]) or 0 local new = tonumber(afterMap[key]) or 0
if old ~= new then local delta = new - old
table.insert( changes, "@C" .. key .. "@W[" .. signed(old) .. "->" .. signed(new) .. " " .. colourDelta(delta) .. signed(delta) .. "@W]" ) end end
return changes end
local function reportComparison(before, after) local parts = {} local scoreText = "unknown"
if before.score ~= nil and after.score ~= nil then local delta = after.score - before.score
scoreText = "@W" .. tostring(before.score) .. "->" .. tostring(after.score) .. " " .. colourDelta(delta) .. signed(delta) .. "@W" end
parts[#parts + 1] = "@M[Reskin]@W" parts[#parts + 1] = "@Y" .. after.name .. "@W" parts[#parts + 1] = "@CScore@W[" .. scoreText .. "]"
local statChanges = buildChanges(before.stats, after.stats) local resistChanges = buildChanges(before.resists, after.resists)
if #statChanges > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = "@CStats@W{" .. table.concat(statChanges, ", ") .. "@W}" end
if #resistChanges > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = "@YResists@W{" .. table.concat(resistChanges, ", ") .. "@W}" end
if #statChanges == 0 and #resistChanges == 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = "@DNo stat or resist changes@W" end
local finalMessage = table.concat(parts, " @D:: @W") .. "@w"
rr.lastReport = finalMessage SetVariable("rr_last_report", finalMessage)
sendReport(finalMessage) end
function rrHelp() blankLine()
ColourNote( "magenta", "", "---------------- Reskin Reporter Help ----------------" )
blankLine() ColourNote("yellow", "", "COMMANDS")
ColourNote("cyan", "", " reskin report <item> [channel]") ColourNote( "white", "", " Identifies the item, reskins it, identifies it again," ) ColourNote( "white", "", " and reports score/stat/resist changes in one message." ) ColourNote( "white", "", " When [channel] is omitted, the result is shown with echo." )
blankLine()
ColourNote("cyan", "", " reskin report last [channel]") ColourNote( "white", "", " Repeats the most recent successful report." ) ColourNote( "white", "", " It does not identify or reskin the item again." ) ColourNote( "white", "", " When [channel] is omitted, the saved result uses echo." )
blankLine()
ColourNote("cyan", "", " reskin report help") ColourNote( "white", "", " Displays this help locally in the MUSHclient output window." )
blankLine() ColourNote("yellow", "", "EXAMPLES") ColourNote("green", "", " reskin report boots") ColourNote("green", "", " reskin report 1.polished gt") ColourNote("green", "", " reskin report 2.'enhanced boots' clantalk") ColourNote("green", "", " reskin report last") ColourNote("green", "", " reskin report last clan")
blankLine() ColourNote("yellow", "", "OPTIONS / NOTES")
ColourTell("cyan", "", " <item>") ColourNote( "white", "", " may be a keyword, numbered keyword, item ID, or quoted keywords." )
ColourTell("cyan", "", " [channel]") ColourNote( "white", "", " is optional and may be say, gt, clan, clantalk, or another" ) ColourNote( "white", "", " recognized channel. Omit it to display the result with echo." )
ColourNote("white", "", " Only changed stats and resists are reported.") ColourNote("white", "", " Score changes are always reported.") ColourNote( "white", "", " The last successful report is saved between MUSHclient sessions." ) ColourNote( "white", "", " Failed reskins do not overwrite the last successful report." )
blankLine() ColourNote( "magenta", "", "--------------------------------------------------------" ) blankLine() end
function rrRepeatLast(name, line, args) local channel = trim(args.channel)
if channel == "" then channel = "echo" end
local lastReport = rr.lastReport
if not lastReport or lastReport == "" then lastReport = GetVariable("rr_last_report") or "" end
if lastReport == "" then ColourNote( "yellow", "", "[Reskin Reporter]: No previous successful reskin report is available." ) return end
sendToChannel(channel, lastReport) end
function rrStart(name, line, args) if rr.active then ColourNote( "yellow", "", "[Reskin Reporter]: A reskin report is already running." ) return end
local item, channel = parseItemAndChannel(args.arguments)
if item == "" then ColourNote( "yellow", "", "[Reskin Reporter]: No item was supplied. Type reskin report help." ) return end
rr.active = true rr.phase = "waiting_before" rr.channel = channel rr.item = item rr.beforeLines = {} rr.afterLines = {} rr.beforeData = nil
SendNoEcho("echo {RESKIN_REPORT_BEFORE_START}") SendNoEcho("identify " .. rr.item) SendNoEcho("echo {RESKIN_REPORT_BEFORE_END}") end
function rrBeforeStart() if not rr.active then return end
rr.phase = "before" rr.beforeLines = {} EnableTrigger("rr_capture_line", true) end
function rrBeforeEnd() if not rr.active or rr.phase ~= "before" then return end
EnableTrigger("rr_capture_line", false) rr.beforeData = parseIdentify(rr.beforeLines)
if rr.beforeData.error or rr.beforeData.score == nil then sendReport("@R[Reskin] Unable to identify item before reskinning.@w") resetReporter() return end
rr.phase = "waiting_reskin" SendNoEcho("reskin " .. rr.item) end
function rrAfterStart() if not rr.active then return end
rr.phase = "after" rr.afterLines = {} EnableTrigger("rr_capture_line", true) end
function rrAfterEnd() if not rr.active or rr.phase ~= "after" then return end
EnableTrigger("rr_capture_line", false)
local afterData = parseIdentify(rr.afterLines)
if afterData.error or afterData.score == nil then sendReport( "@R[Reskin] Reskin succeeded, but the second identify failed.@w" ) resetReporter() return end
if rr.beforeData.id and afterData.id and rr.beforeData.id ~= afterData.id then sendReport( "@R[Reskin] Item ID changed unexpectedly; report cancelled for safety.@w" ) resetReporter() return end
reportComparison(rr.beforeData, afterData) resetReporter() end
function rrCaptureLine(name, line, args) if not rr.active then return end
if rr.phase == "before" then table.insert(rr.beforeLines, args.captured or line)
elseif rr.phase == "after" then table.insert(rr.afterLines, args.captured or line) end end
function rrReskinSuccess(name, line, args) if not rr.active or rr.phase ~= "waiting_reskin" then return end
rr.phase = "waiting_after"
SendNoEcho("echo {RESKIN_REPORT_AFTER_START}") SendNoEcho("identify " .. rr.item) SendNoEcho("echo {RESKIN_REPORT_AFTER_END}") end
function rrReskinFailure(name, line, args) if not rr.active or rr.phase ~= "waiting_reskin" then return end
local reason = args.reason or line or "Reskin failed."
sendReport("@R[Reskin] " .. reason .. "@w") resetReporter() end
function OnPluginInstall() rr.lastReport = GetVariable("rr_last_report") or "" resetReporter() end
function OnPluginClose() resetReporter() end
